package_info.why_malicious: This report does not describe any specific malicious package or code. Instead, it provides a high-level overview of common vulnerability types (RCE, XSS, DoS) in the .NET ecosystem, their prevalence, and remediation strategies. No individual package or code is identified as malicious.

behavioral_signatures: Remote code execution via arbitrary command or code execution over the network
Cross-site scripting: injection of untrusted data into web application output
Denial of service: resource exhaustion or service unavailability attacks
file_indicators: No specific file indicators provided in the report
network_indicators: No specific network indicators provided in the report
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for patterns of remote code execution, cross-site scripting, and denial of service vulnerabilities in .NET applications. Use static and dynamic analysis tools to identify code paths that allow arbitrary code execution, unvalidated user input reflected in web output, or resource exhaustion. Regularly scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities using tools like Snyk, and keep all packages up to date with security patches.
